description: Save connection credentials to the env file for later requests (any subset; auth / oauth_client_id / oauth_grant pick the method). Secrets are never arguments: list them in request_secrets for elicitation. See 'instance' for host changes.

instance.description: Instance host, e.g. 'dev12345'. A change needs the new host's auth in the same call (Basic: user + password, else CREDENTIALS_INCOMPLETE) and elicitation confirmation unless SN_ALLOW_UNCONFIRMED_CREDENTIAL_CHANGE=1.

profile.description: Profile (default active); a new name creates one.

request_secrets.description: Secrets to enter through elicitation (never as arguments).

name: servicenow_set_credentials
title: Set ServiceNow credentials
